title: Production Officer
description:
Production - API (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient) Department Experience: 1-5 Years
 Education: B.Sc./M.Sc. Chemistry, B.Tech (Chemical/Chemistry) Role & Responsibilities Operate and monitor API manufacturing processes as per Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR). Handle chemical reactions, distillation, filtration, centrifugation, drying, and other API production activities. Ensure adherence to GMP, SOPs, safety, and quality standards during manufacturing. Perform equipment operation, cleaning, and line clearance activities. Monitor process parameters and report deviations, incidents, and abnormalities. Maintain production documentation accurately and timely. Coordinate with QA, QC, Engineering, and EHS teams for smooth production operations. Support process optimization, productivity improvement, and cost-reduction initiatives. Ensure compliance with Data Integrity and regulatory requirements. Participate in shift operations and achieve production targets. Preferred Candidate Profile B.Sc./M.Sc. in Chemistry or B.Tech in Chemical/Chemistry. 1-5 years of experience in API/Pharmaceutical Manufacturing. Good understanding of API production processes and shop-floor operations. Knowledge of GMP, cGMP, EHS, SOPs, and documentation practices. Exposure to reactors, centrifuges, dryers, and other process equipment. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work in shifts and cross-functional teams. Good communication and documentation skills. Perks & Benefits Attractive salary and performance-linked rewards. Provident Fund (PF), Gratuity, and statutory benefits. Group Mediclaim and Personal Accident Insurance. Subsidized canteen and transport facilities (as per company policy). Learning & Development opportunities and career growth. Employee wellness and engagement programs. Safe and compliant work environment. Internal job opportunities across Lupin locations. Job Title: Executive / Officer - Production (API)
 Location: Lupin Limited, API Manufacturing Facility.

Key Skills: Dryer,CGMP,Production,API Production,Chemical,Centrifuge,API,Reactors
